title: Introduce multi-objective evaluator, per-cohort telemetry adapter, and CI decision latch
author: Priya Shah
description: Motivation: Existing eval gating is single-metric and brittle for composite workloads where latency, factuality, and semantic similarity trade off. This PR adds a MultiObjectiveEvaluator that computes a normalized score vector per prompt set, a Pareto-inspired ranking utility, and a lightweight cohort-telemetry adapter that emits per-cohort quantiles for each objective. Additionally, a CI decision latch hook (ci-decision-latch) is introduced to allow the CI pipeline to make merge/no-merge decisions based on composite thresholds and cooldown semantics. Changes are designed to be backwards compatible: if a project config declares a single primary metric, existing gates behave the same. Key features: 1) MultiObjectiveEvaluator: vector scoring with pluggable normalizers and a configurable aggregation policy (weighted sum, min-rank, pareto-count). 2) CohortTelemetryAdapter: emits cohort-level p50/p90/p99 and regression deltas to our metrics backend and attaches a compact signature to CI artifacts for reproducibility. 3) CI Decision Latch: a pipeline hook that consumes summary artifacts and either allows a merge, blocks it, or marks it as manual-review depending on threshold crossings and a team-configured grace window. 4) Opt-out/escape hatch: label "ci/bypass-eval-latch" allows maintainers to override the latch when needed with audit logging. 5) Migration path: new evaluator is behind a feature flag eval.multi_objective.enabled=false by default; docs and a migration script are provided. Scope: evaluator core, telemetry adapter, CI hook, unit+integration tests, docs and a short runbook for oncall. Rollout plan: enable in a canary repo for 2 weeks, monitor cohort telemetry signals for unexpected variance, then flip feature flag account-wide. Backwards-compatibility notes: default config retains previous single-metric gate behavior for all existing prompt sets. Security/perf: cohort adapter uses batched emission and async workers to avoid test-run latency impact. See release_notes for short summary.
commit_summary: Commit 1: add multi_objective evaluator and normalization utilities; Commit 2: add cohort telemetry adapter and metrics schema; Commit 3: add ci-decision-latch pipeline hook and CLI; Commit 4: tests and docs; Commit 5: address reviewer feedback and tighten defaults

Priya Shah: Added tests for zero variance and explicit docs on weight scaling, and made normalizers tolerant to constant vectors.

Evan Brooks: CI hook looks good but prefer that the default action on marginal failure is 'manual-review' not 'block'. Also request a short circuit for very large prompt sets to avoid long eval times.
Priya Shah: Changed default to 'manual-review' and added sample-rate gating for large prompt sets with a 10k sample cutoff and deterministic sampling.
Sana Iqbal: Suggest moving the feature flag to runtime-config store and not a static env var so ops can flip without deploy.
Priya Shah: Moved flag to runtime-config and added an escape hatch label; included runbook steps for ops to update the flag.
Evan Brooks: Approving pending small nits in CLI help text.
